jira.note: The command must be this launch script, not `uvx mcp-atlassian` directly -- mcp-atlassian needs JIRA_URL/JIRA_USERNAME/JIRA_API_TOKEN, and this script reads them from a .env file outside the project (~/.config/mcp-atlassian/sessions/<destination>.env, same directory on macOS/Linux/Windows via Python's Path.home()) and execs uvx with them. Never put credentials in this file or in .env in git.
